scope: Read-only offline local stack review; only these two evidence documents were written. No source edits, hardware reads, controls, builds, tests, external research or refreshed boot inventory.
assessment: Reuse the existing Gravity Linux Asahi G16 backend and Gravity Mesa Gallium/GBM/EGL stack. Prioritize an end-to-end T6040 render path and start driver/Mesa integration in parallel with the firmware application proof. Additional management-only restarts do not prove rendering.

facts.claim: Gravity already provides a render-node DRM frontend, GEM buffers, VM create/bind, queues, submit, syncobj timelines, DMA fences, scheduler and ordinary-buffer PRIME export. VM-private buffer export is intentionally rejected. These interfaces are implemented source, not T6040 live proof.
Existing G16 TA/fragment rendering and VM implementations can be adapted; a new Linux graphics API or new Mesa compiler/compositor stack is unnecessary.

T6040 normal startup is explicitly refused and probe-only does not register DRM. The normal backend still advertises variant G, chip 0x8132, one cluster and one core mask; platform hardware-data builders retain donor assumptions. Enabling normal startup alone would not implement G16S.

Mesa recognizes G16S metadata but returns false because firmware/packet layouts are unqualified. Apple9 direct rendering and shader-entry setup select G16G/G17P, not G16S. Compute is G16G-only and is not a prerequisite for an initial graphical desktop.

A saved 2026-10-06 receipt records successful offline kernel/module and Mesa builds and a workspace Mesa installation. Local Gallium, GBM and EGL libraries exist. This does not establish hardware GL or installation into the active desktop session.

The cited v11 saved evidence proves one management OFF/ON/OFF, with application rejoin 0. Both EP32/33 were started cold, but the retained map acknowledged no application endpoints. Initial class86 recovery failed before first OFF. Truthful bitmap 3 is a supported next hypothesis; it is not firmware acceptance or application command consumption proof.

The saved 2026-10-07 baseline found no DCP/DISP/crossbar/panel DT nodes and only the chosen framebuffer via simpledrm. The inspected native-reset config has DRM_APPLE disabled and simpledrm enabled. Existing DCP source has an IOMFB26.6 path and explicit T8132/26.6.2 gating; T6040 display topology/provider/stream/reservation integration remains. This is not a new live DT inventory.

Two static KWin user-service overrides force KWIN_COMPOSE=Q. The SDDM greeter separately forces software Qt/GL. Actual accelerated-session validation must select hardware rendering and account for both KWin overrides after EGL/GBM works. No config was changed.

headless_render_critical_path: Prove cold firmware application control consumption and idle; publish one owned TA/3D job with a completion event/fence and correct pixel readback. Management endpoint replies alone do not satisfy this.
Port the demonstrated T6040 startup/initdata/power/application contract and truthful topology into the existing Gravity backend; use its DRM VM/queue/submit/fence interfaces.

Qualify the G16S graphics command, shader-entry and tiling/resource layouts, then enable the appropriate existing Mesa Apple9 path. Validate repeated headless EGL/GBM rendering, textures/blits and synchronization rather than only one triangle.
desktop_presentation_after_headless_rend: Validate buffer export/import, supported formats/modifiers, completion fences and compositor device selection. A triangle does not itself validate those interfaces.
Switch KWin from its explicit QPainter overrides for a controlled hardware session once the render path is demonstrated.
For native scanout, implement T6040 DCP DT resources/providers/stream identities/reservations and appropriate firmware/hardware support; this is separate from headless rendering.

interim_presentation_hypothesis.status: Untested inference; not a promised desktop shortcut
interim_presentation_hypothesis.basis: simpledrm performs CPU access and damage blits into the boot framebuffer; the GPU frontend can export ordinary BOs.
interim_presentation_hypothesis.proposal: Explore offscreen GPU rendering with an explicit copy or readback into the existing simpledrm presentation path.
interim_presentation_hypothesis.required_viability: Actual KWin/GBM/EGL device selection and import or copy support, CPU-mappable formats/modifiers, synchronization, conversion and acceptable copy performance must be demonstrated. PRIME export alone does not prove cross-device presentation.

parallel_work_now: Adapt normal-driver topology/resource/initdata and Mesa G16S graphics support offline while the minimal firmware execution proof is prepared.
Prepare headless EGL/GBM exercise and desktop buffer/compositor integration analysis without waiting for perfect standalone teardown.
Develop native DCP display integration as a separate workstream.
not_required_before_first_headless_rende: Native DCP takeover or external display support
Full suspend/resume, dynamic power tuning, complete unload and retirement of every backing object
Further management-only restart epochs beyond the bounded evidence needed for the chosen execution profile
retained_constraints: Ownership, valid address/layout bindings, bounded submission, actual completion and backing lifetime remain necessary. Keeping the GPU powered for an initial vertical slice can defer advanced PM without discarding these execution requirements.
apple_driver_reuse: The macOS Apple AGX driver is valuable ABI/lifecycle evidence. Its IOKit implementation is not a Linux-loadable replacement for Gravity DRM/Mesa; transfer proven contracts into the existing Linux stack.
